leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the styled-components library to install and import necessary dependencies for styling React components.
Construct styled components using the `styled` function to create reusable UI elements with encapsulated styles.
Utilize template literals to define CSS properties within styled component declarations.
Implement TypeScript interfaces to type props that will be passed to styled components.
Access component props within styled component definitions to create dynamic styles based on props.
Control style inheritance by composing styled components from other styled components using the `styled()` constructor.
Define global styles using `createGlobalStyle` to apply base CSS rules across the entire application.
Execute conditional styling by applying different CSS rules based on prop values using ternary operators or functions.
Modify component behavior by extending existing styled components with additional styles using the `styled()` function.
Return styled components within React component trees to render styled UI elements.
Assign theme values to styled components by wrapping the application with `ThemeProvider` and accessing theme props.
Handle responsive design by implementing media queries within styled component template literals.
